capabilities.description: Create and send new messages, replies, reply-all, and forwarded messages with full control over content and recipients.
capabilities.notes: Compose mode available for new messages, replies, reply-all, and forwards. Smart Alerts (OnMessageSend) requires Mailbox 1.12+. OnMessageRecipientsChanged event available in Mailbox 1.11+

capabilities.description: Get and set the subject line of messages in compose and read modes using async methods.
capabilities.notes: Minimum 255 characters. Read-only in read mode. getAsync/setAsync required in compose mode.

capabilities.description: Save draft messages programmatically during composition to get item IDs and manage unsaved state.
capabilities.notes: saveAsync introduced in Mailbox 1.3. getItemIdAsync introduced in Mailbox 1.8 for easier draft identification.

capabilities.description: Access and work with threaded messages and conversation data within Outlook.
capabilities.notes: Body retrieval supports bodyMode option (FullBody, HostConfig) to respect user's message organization setting.

capabilities.description: Get and set start/end times for appointments being composed using async methods.
capabilities.notes: Returns/accepts UTC Date objects. Minimum Mailbox 1.1. Read-only in read mode for attendees.

capabilities.description: Manage appointment locations with enhanced location API supporting location types (room, address, URL, etc.).
capabilities.notes: enhancedLocation (Mailbox 1.8+) supports LocationIdentifier with types. location (Mailbox 1.1+) for basic string-based locations.

capabilities.description: Get and set recurring appointment patterns (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) with complex properties.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.7+. Organizers can set; attendees read-only. Supports SeriesTime object for date/time ranges.

capabilities.description: Work with meeting requests, responses (Accept, Tentative, Decline), and meeting cancellations.
capabilities.notes: Attendees can propose new times. Organizers control final details. Reply mode extends compose capabilities.

capabilities.description: Get, set, and add recipients (To, Cc, Bcc) for messages and required/optional attendees for appointments.
capabilities.notes: Returns EmailAddressDetails objects. Compose mode requires getAsync due to async nature. recipient types: smtp, gal, list

capabilities.description: Detect when recipients are added or removed in a message being composed.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.11+. Mobile support: Android 4.2425.0+, iOS 4.2425.0+. Event provides access to current recipients.

capabilities.description: Validate email addresses and resolve recipients against the Global Address List.
capabilities.notes: Automatic validation through Outlook. Can detect distribution lists and external recipients.

capabilities.description: Detect when the From field (sender account) changes in a message or appointment organizer.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.13+. Useful for updating signatures based on active account. Mobile support for OnMessageFromChanged.

capabilities.description: Limited support for Task item types in Outlook add-ins; primarily handled through other item types.
capabilities.notes: Tasks are read-only in add-ins. No compose mode support. Focus is on Message and Appointment types.

capabilities.description: Add file attachments and Outlook item attachments to messages and appointments during composition.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.1 for classic/Mac, 1.8+ for web/new Windows. Base64 encoding (1.8+) for binary files. Item attachment supports messages/appointments.

capabilities.description: Get attachment metadata and content from read-mode messages and appointments.
capabilities.notes: attachments property (1.1+) for read mode. getAttachmentsAsync (1.8+) for compose. Returns AttachmentDetails array.

capabilities.description: Download attachment content as Base64-encoded data from Exchange for processing or storage.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.8+. Returns Base64-encoded content. Can retrieve from Exchange or via Microsoft Graph REST API.

capabilities.description: Encrypt and decrypt message attachments for enhanced security and compliance.
capabilities.notes: Custom encryption logic required. OnAttachmentAdded event (Mailbox 1.10+) triggers encryption on file add.

capabilities.description: Embed Base64-encoded images inline in message body using Content ID references.
capabilities.notes: Use cid:filename references in HTML body. addFileAttachmentFromBase64Async (1.8+). Body APIs Mailbox 1.1+.

capabilities.description: Detect when attachments are added or removed from a message or appointment.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.10+. OnAttachmentAdded can trigger automatic processing (e.g., encryption).

capabilities.description: Create, retrieve, and manage the master list of color-coded categories for a mailbox.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.8+. Returns CategoryDetails array with name and color. Requires MailboxItem or Mailbox permissions.

capabilities.description: Apply, retrieve, and remove categories from individual messages and appointments.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.8+. Categories must exist in master list first. Async operations for compose mode.

capabilities.description: Get, set, and manage Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity labels on messages and appointments.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.13+. Requires Microsoft 365 E5 or trial. Catalog must be enabled. Supports sublabels.

capabilities.description: Detect when a sensitivity label is applied, changed, or removed from a message or appointment.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.13+. Allows automatic reactions to label changes (e.g., disabling external recipients).

capabilities.description: Execute code when user selects Send on a message, allowing validation, modification, or blocking of send.
capabilities.apiEntryPoint: OnMessageSend event with Smart Alerts support (PromptUser, SoftBlock, Block send modes)
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.12+. Send modes: PromptUser (default), SoftBlock, Block. Can programmatically send after validation.

capabilities.description: Execute code when user selects Send on an appointment/meeting request, enabling validation and modification.
capabilities.apiEntryPoint: OnAppointmentSend event with same Smart Alerts modes as OnMessageSend
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.12+. Block/SoftBlock/PromptUser modes available. Can enforce compliance policies before send.

capabilities.description: Automatically run code when a new message composition is initiated (new, reply, reply-all, forward).
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.10+. Mobile support (Android/iOS 4.2352.0+). Can auto-populate subject, body, signatures.

capabilities.description: Automatically run code when a new appointment or meeting request composition is initiated.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.10+. Can set initial subject, time, location, and required attendees.

capabilities.description: Execute code when a message is opened for reading, enabling encryption/decryption and specialized processing.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.15 (Preview). Currently classic Outlook Windows only (v2510+). Requires registry setting for beta APIs.

capabilities.description: Notify add-in when a different message or appointment is selected, updating task pane UI accordingly.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.5+. Enables pinnable task panes to update on item selection. Used for keeping task pane open.

capabilities.description: Handle drag-and-drop of messages and attachments into add-in task pane with file content access.
capabilities.notes: Web/new Windows: Office.js API. Classic/Mac: HTML Drag and Drop API. Files returned as .eml (web/new) or .msg/.eml.

capabilities.description: Get body content in HTML or plain text format, and set/insert body content during composition.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.1+. Compose: setAsync/prependAsync for text or HTML. Read: bodyMode option (1.11+) for conversation control.

capabilities.description: Set or replace email signatures, including account-specific signatures on From field changes.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.10+. setSignatureAsync inserts at end. disableClientSignatureAsync prevents default signature. Mobile support (1.10+).

capabilities.description: Insert formatted HTML content into messages and appointments with support for inline images and styles.
capabilities.notes: Verify body type with getTypeAsync before inserting. HTML text format may need conversion from plain text items.

capabilities.description: Insert content at the current cursor position in the message or appointment body.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.1+. Max 1,000,000 characters per insertion. Replaces selected text if any. Fails if cursor simultaneously changed.

capabilities.description: Insert Base64-encoded images directly into message body as inline images using Content ID.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.8+. Must call body.getAsync first. Use cid:filename in HTML img src. Set isInline: true in attachment options.

capabilities.description: Store and retrieve custom metadata on individual mail items, accessible only by the add-in that created it.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.1+. Data persists in Exchange. Not accessible after item leaves server. Max 32KB total.

capabilities.description: Store and retrieve user preferences and mailbox-level settings accessible across all devices and sessions.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.1+. JSON-serialized data. Roams across devices. Must call saveAsync to persist. ~32KB limit.

capabilities.description: Store temporary data for the current composition session only, cleared when compose completes.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.11+. Data not persisted after send/discard. Useful for draft-specific state. Mobile support (4.2425.0+).

capabilities.description: Set, get, and remove custom internet headers on messages for cross-client and cross-server identification.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.8+. Headers persist after send. Mobile support (Android/iOS 4.2405.0+). Custom headers identified by X- prefix convention.

capabilities.description: Run event handlers automatically on Android and iOS Outlook clients for message compose and recipient changes.
capabilities.apiEntryPoint: OnNewMessageCompose, OnMessageRecipientsChanged, OnMessageFromChanged events on mobile
capabilities.notes: Android/iOS Mailbox 1.5 core, 1.11+ for extended events. Supports signature management and recipient detection on mobile.

capabilities.description: Subset of Office.js APIs now enabled for Outlook mobile clients despite Mailbox 1.5 core support.
capabilities.apiEntryPoint: Limited APIs from Mailbox 1.7-1.14 (see docs for complete list)
capabilities.notes: Android/iOS support varies by API. addFileAttachmentFromBase64Async (4.2352.0+), setSignatureAsync, body.getTypeAsync supported.

capabilities.description: Design and implement add-in task panes optimized for Outlook mobile clients on iOS and Android.
capabilities.apiEntryPoint: MobileMessageReadCommandSurface ExtensionPoint with mobile button controls
capabilities.notes: Only Message Read mode primarily supported. Meeting/CRM apps can use Appointment modes. Icon sizes: 16x16, 32x32, 80x80 pixels.

capabilities.description: Create online meetings from Outlook mobile appointments using integrated providers like Teams.
capabilities.notes: Exception to mobile compose limitations. Requires provider integration. Android/iOS support.

capabilities.description: Allow Outlook mobile users to log meeting details to external systems (CRM, note-taking) in attendee mode.
capabilities.notes: For CRM and note-taking apps. Provides read-only appointment details in mobile attendee view.

capabilities.description: Display a vertical task pane for detailed add-in interactions, accessible from ribbon buttons or contextual triggers.
capabilities.notes: Default add-in integration method. Supports SourceLocation with URL. Can be triggered by ribbon buttons or contextual add-ins.

capabilities.description: Allow users to keep a task pane open across messages without closing, improving heavy-use workflows.
capabilities.apiEntryPoint: SupportsPinning element in manifest action definition
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.5+. Supported in modern Outlook web, new Windows, classic 2016+, and Mac 16.13+. Not supported for appointments.

capabilities.description: Execute background functions triggered by ribbon buttons without displaying visible UI.
capabilities.notes: Uses Runtime for execution. Can perform background tasks like validation or API calls. Returns completion status.

capabilities.description: Activate add-in automatically when specific text patterns (regex) are found in message body.
capabilities.notes: Read mode only. Entity-based activation deprecated. Uses getRegExMatches() and getRegExMatchesByName().

capabilities.description: Operate on multiple selected messages at once for bulk operations like categorization or upload.
capabilities.apiEntryPoint: SupportsMultiSelect element in manifest with multiselect: true in runtime actions
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.13+. Get selected items via Office.context.mailbox.getSelectedItemsAsync(). Classic Windows only (unified manifest).

capabilities.description: Activate add-in task pane even when no message is selected, for mailbox-wide operations.
capabilities.apiEntryPoint: supportsNoItemContext: true in runtime actions (unified manifest)
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.15+. Enables add-in access without selecting a mail item. Useful for mailbox-level operations.

capabilities.description: Integrate with Outlook's native spam reporting UI to report unsolicited emails to your backend system.
capabilities.apiEntryPoint: SpamReporting event with preprocessing dialog and SpamReporting action in manifest
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.14+. Prominent ribbon placement. Dialog supports checkboxes, radio buttons (Mac preview), text input. File export for processing.

capabilities.description: Access Outlook mail REST APIs through Microsoft Graph for advanced scenarios beyond Office.js.
capabilities.apiEntryPoint: Nested App Authentication (NAA) for token, then fetch https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0 endpoints
capabilities.notes: Requires NAA implementation. Access item ID via itemId (convert with convertToRestId for REST). Query filters and projections supported.

capabilities.description: Get callback token for server-side EWS calls to perform operations not available via Office.js.
capabilities.notes: Deprecated approach; use Microsoft Graph via NAA instead. Mailbox 1.1+. Token valid for one EWS call.

capabilities.description: Retrieve attachment content and metadata via Microsoft Graph REST API when Office.js APIs insufficient.
capabilities.notes: Preferred for Outlook on-premises environments. Requires item ID conversion to REST format.

capabilities.description: Access and perform operations on shared mailboxes that users have permissions to manage.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.13+. Exchange Online supported. Desktop/web/Mac support varies. Auto-mapped by admin or user-added.

capabilities.description: Work with folders delegated to you by other mailbox owners, including calendar and inbox folders.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.8+. Delegate configures access via Outlook settings. Add-in APIs work transparently on delegate's folders.

capabilities.description: Obtain access tokens for Microsoft Graph and external APIs using the user's identity without prompting.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.12+. Replaces deprecated token methods. Requires backend service to exchange for Graph token.

capabilities.description: Convert Exchange Web Services item IDs to REST-compatible IDs for Microsoft Graph operations.
capabilities.notes: Mailbox 1.3+. Required for non-mobile clients when using REST APIs. Specify Office.MailboxEnums.RestVersion.v2_0.

capabilities.description: Check whether user has allowed the add-in to open from and save to cloud storage locations.
capabilities.notes: No minimum requirement set; used to check capabilities before attempting cloud operations.

capabilities.description: Detect whether user is managed by their organization (AAD identity) vs. personal account.
capabilities.notes: No min requirement set. Mobile support (Android/iOS 4.2443.0+). Useful for license checking or feature availability.
